content: ज {%a.%} [जि-जन्-जु-वा ड] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Born from or in, produced or caused by, descended from, growing in, living or being at or in <ab>&c.</ab>; अत्रिनेत्रज, कुलज, जलज, क्षत्रियज, अण्डज, उद्भिज <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Prepared from, made of. .²3 Belonging to, connected with, peculiar to. .²4 Swift. .²5 Victorious, conquering. .{@-जः@} .²1 A father. .²2 Production, birth. .²3 Poison. .²4 An imp or goblin. .²5 A conqueror. .²6 Lustre. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²9 Enjoyment. .²10 Speed, swiftness. .²11 (In prosody) One of the eight syllabic feet (गण); जो जारः जा योनिः and जं च जातं रजतमेव च . <ls>Enm.</ls> The <ls>Nm.</ls> of राघव says: जो जये विजये मेरौ शब्दे जेतरि मत्सरे . and जं कटीभूषणे पत्न्यां तेजस्यम्बुनि जन्मनि .
